visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair sits on a gray couch in a bright indoor living room. She holds a large plush head of a cartoon girl with bells in her hair. She smiles warmly at the camera. Behind her is a light tan dog. (2) She presents a boxed figurine of Sun Xiaomei (A-prize). She unboxes it to show the figurine on a stand with dice and golden ingots. Her hands are active, gesturing toward the items. (3) She shows a second box (B-prize) featuring Uncle Atu. She displays the figurine, which is an elderly man in a straw hat and overalls, alongside larger golden coin accessories on a white base. (4) She introduces the C-prize, consisting of a Baby King figurine and a small yellow duck-shaped vehicle. She holds them both in her palms to show the scale and detailing of the toys. (5) She picks up the large plush head again (D-prize), shaking it to demonstrate its size and the physical bells attached. She wears a black long-sleeved shirt and red shorts. (6) She reveals smaller prizes: a glass with a character print (E-prize), plush card holders (F-prize), and sets of memo pads (G-prize) and phone stands (H-prize). (7) Finally, she gathers the main prizes in her arms and talks directly to the camera. Traditional Chinese subtitles are visible at the bottom of the screen throughout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a bright, energetic female voice greeting the audience. Background music is a high-tempo, retro MIDI-style synthesizer track reminiscent of old computer games. A crisp plastic rustling sound is heard as a package is handled. (2) As the creator reveals the first prize, an iconic 'ding' sound effect from the Richman game is heard. Her speech is fast-paced and cheerful. The background music remains consistent in the mix, never overpowering her voice. (3) Several metallic clicks and soft thuds occur as figurines are placed on stands. A distinct bell sound effect triggers when she points out the bells on the plush toy. Her pitch remains high and engaging throughout the description. (4) In the final segment, the voice quality remains clear and professional. The BGM continues with a bouncy, repetitive rhythm until a final game-style chime concludes the clip. The interplay between the nostalgic music and upbeat narration creates a happy, promotional mood.
